context.content: I think it's unfortunate so many people suggest ING or ABN Amro, while you specifically noted to be interested in sustainable banking. ING and ABN are actually some of the worst banks out there. In my oppinion you have 3 options: - Bunq. Very internationally focused, support is always available in English and Dutch but also in different languages (Spanish, Italian, german, maybe more) depending who's on the other end (they also integrate google translate in their support app but not sure how well that works). You can choose yourself how (and if) your money is invested and they try to become carbon neutral. - Any other branch of Volksbank, being (apart from ASN) SNS and Regiobank. I have no idea if they do English though - Triodos bank. Another bank famous for its sustainability that's also active in the UK amongst other countries, but I'm not sure if they do english support for NL accounts. Also I know from personal experience it's quite a hassle to open an account with them.
